acquisition method: MS data was acquired using a data-dependent top10 method
alkylation reagent: Iodoacetamide (40 mM) was then added to alkylate
alkylation concentration: Iodoacetamide (40 mM) was then added to alkylate
cleavage agent: A mixture of trypsin/lysozyme C (2 µg) was added and digestion was performed
collision energy: the Normalized collision energy was 30 eV
enrichment method: ultrafiltration combined with size exclusion chromatography (UF-SEC)
ultrafiltration combined with size exclusion chromatography (UF-SEC) provides well-matched concentrates of EVs
fractionation method: 500 µl of concentrated media was applied to a 10 ml sepharose CL-4B SEC column
fragmentation method: Resolution for HCD spectra was set to 17,500
instrument: coupled in-line with a Q Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
ionization type: with a nano-electrospray Flex ion source (Proxeon, Thermo Fisher Scientific)
labeling: Proteomic analysis was performed by nano LC-MS/MS for UF-SEC EVs, UC EVs or UF-SEC protein fractions.
reduction reagent: To 5 µg of protein per sample, DTT (20 mM) was added
reduction concentration: To 5 µg of protein per sample, DTT (20 mM) was added
